name: DiscoveryBench
why_it_matters: Data journalists routinely need to surface the story hidden in messy CSVs, and this benchmark measures exactly that end-to-end discovery workflow.
task_shape: Given a real-world tabular dataset and a discovery goal, the model must run multi-step analysis to produce a hypothesis or finding, evaluated against ground-truth discoveries from published research.
signals: Uses 264 real discovery tasks derived from published papers across domains like sociology, economics, and biology, giving realistic messiness.
Ground-truth findings are singular and pre-specified, so genuine alternative stories a journalist might legitimately surface are marked wrong.
